name: vt-cli
description: Official VirusTotal command-line interface for scanning files and querying threat intelligence

vt.description: VirusTotal CLI - scan files, get reports, and query threat intelligence from command line
vt.usage:
vt init
vt file scan malware.exe
vt file info SHA256_HASH
vt url scan https://example.com
vt search 'type:peexe positives:10+'
vt domain info example.com
